def createSummary(self, log):
        """
        Match log lines against warningPattern.

        Warnings are collected into another log for this step, and the
        build-wide 'warnings-count' is updated."""
        log.info('Creating summary...')
        self.summary = self.build.createTextLog(self.name)
        self.summary.write(self.warningPattern.pattern() + '\n')
        self.summary.write('----------------------------------------\n')
        self.summary.write('%d warnings found\n' % self.warningCount)
        self.summary.write('----------------------------------------\n')
        self.summary.write(self.warningPattern.pattern() + '\n')
        self.summary.write('----------------------------------------\n')
        self.build.setProperty('warnings-count', str(self.warningCount))
